English: Yogagarhi is made up of two words: yoga and garhi. Yoga means union, and garhi means fortress. Yes, a fort, that's what we are.
Translation: YogaGarhi besteht aus zwei Wörtern: Yoga und Garhi. Yoga bedeutet Einheit, und Garhi bedeutet Festung. Ja, eine Festung – genau das sind wir.
Back-translation: Yogagarhi is made up of two words: yoga and garhi. Yoga means union, and garhi means fortress. Yes, a fort, that's what we are.

English: We are a fortress that protects the true essence of yoga from outside influences, distortions, and dilution. It is a place where the timeless wisdom contained in the authentic principles of yoga is preserved and passed on with utmost care.
Translation: Wir sind eine Festung, die das wahre Wesen des Yoga vor äußeren Einflüssen, Verzerrungen und Verwässerung schützt. Ein Ort, an dem die zeitlose Weisheit authentischer Yoga-Prinzipien bewahrt und mit größter Hingabe weitergegeben wird.
Back-translation: We are a fortress that protects the true essence of yoga from outside influences, distortions, and dilution. It is a place where the timeless wisdom contained in the authentic principles of yoga is preserved and passed on with utmost care.

English: A fort is situated at a much higher altitude than its surroundings. For us, the true foundation or essence of Yoga lies in the highest philosophy of Advaita or non-duality. Yogagarhi isn't just a yoga school. It's a fortress of wisdom, awareness, and inner freedom.
Translation: Eine Festung liegt auf einer deutlich höheren Ebene als ihre Umgebung. Für uns liegt das wahre Fundament des Yoga in der höchsten Philosophie des Advaita oder der Nicht-Dualität. YogaGarhi ist nicht nur eine Yogaschule. Es ist eine Festung der Weisheit, Achtsamkeit und inneren Freiheit.
Back-translation: A fort is situated at a much higher altitude than its surroundings. For us, the true foundation or essence of Yoga lies in the highest philosophy of Advaita or non-duality. Yogagarhi isn't just a yoga school. It's a fortress of wisdom, awareness, and inner freedom.

English: A fearless child, a curious teen, and a heart that kept seeking. This journey gradually shaped a revolutionary man, not driven by rebellion, but by awareness. What began as exploration unfolded into a life devoted to practice, discipline, teaching, and service.
Translation: Ein furchtloses Kind, ein neugieriger Jugendlicher und ein Herz, das unermüdlich suchte. Diese Reise formte schrittweise einen revolutionären Mann – nicht getrieben von Rebellion, sondern von Bewusstheit. Was als Erkundung begann, entfaltete sich zu einem Leben, das der Praxis, Disziplin, Lehre und dem Dienen gewidmet ist.
Back-translation: A fearless child, a curious teen, and a heart that kept seeking. This journey gradually shaped a revolutionary man, not driven by rebellion, but by awareness. What began as exploration unfolded into a life devoted to practice, discipline, teaching, and service.

English: "Yoga was not found in a single moment; it revealed itself slowly, through experience, inquiry, inner silence, and lived understanding."
Translation: "Yoga wurde nicht in einem einzigen Moment gefunden; es offenbarte sich langsam durch Erfahrung, Nachforschung, innere Stille und gelebtes Verstehen."
Back-translation: "Yoga was not found in a single moment; it revealed itself slowly, through experience, inquiry, inner silence, and lived understanding."

English: Even after teaching yoga for seven years at a reputed yoga teacher training school, there was still a sense of incompleteness within me. I felt something was missing. We were teaching anatomy, demonstrating postures, teaching alignment, and giving certificates, but something deeper was absent.
Translation: Selbst nachdem ich sieben Jahre lang an einer renommierten Yogaschule unterrichtet hatte, spürte ich noch immer ein Gefühl der Unvollständigkeit in mir. Ich fühlte, dass etwas fehlte. Wir lehrten Anatomie, demonstrierten Haltungen, korrigierten Ausrichtungen und vergaben Zertifikate – aber etwas Tieferes fehlte.
Back-translation: Even after teaching yoga for seven years at a reputed yoga teacher training school, there was still a sense of incompleteness within me. I felt something was missing. We were teaching anatomy, demonstrating postures, teaching alignment, and giving certificates, but something deeper was absent.

English: After a long period of observation, I realized that we live in duality: I and the world, day and night, pleasure and pain. The sages have said that this duality is the cause of all human suffering. Therefore, life is a journey from duality (dwaita) to non-duality (Advaita).
Translation: Nach einer langen Phase der Beobachtung erkannte ich, dass wir in Dualität leben: Ich und die Welt, Tag und Nacht, Freude und Schmerz. Die Weisen sagten, dass diese Dualität die Ursache allen menschlichen Leidens ist. Daher ist das Leben eine Reise von der Dualität (Dwaita) zur Nicht-Dualität (Advaita).
Back-translation: After a long period of observation, I realized that we live in duality: I and the world, day and night, pleasure and pain. The sages have said that this duality is the cause of all human suffering. Therefore, life is a journey from duality (dwaita) to non-duality (Advaita).

English: From this understanding, YogaGarhi was born. A fortress where yoga is lived, not merely taught; rooted in awareness, inner silence, and the timeless wisdom of the ancient sages.
Translation: Aus diesem Verständnis heraus wurde YogaGarhi geboren. Eine Festung, in der Yoga gelebt und nicht nur gelehrt wird; verwurzelt in Bewusstheit, innerer Stille und der zeitlosen Weisheit der alten Weisen.
Back-translation: From this understanding, YogaGarhi was born. A fortress where yoga is lived, not merely taught; rooted in awareness, inner silence, and the timeless wisdom of the ancient sages.
